झञ्झन झञ्झन, अम्, n. (onomatopoetic),
an indistinct noise like the jingling and clanking of
metal ornaments, any ringing or rattling sound.

झञ्झा, f. the noise of the wind or of falling
rain; wind, wind and rain, a hurricane, a gale; a
clang or sharp clanking sound, jingling; raining in
large drops; a stray, anything lost.
—झञ्झानिल
(˚झा-अन्˚), अस्, m. wind with rain, a high wind in
the rainy season, a typhoon or the sort of tempest
frequent during the south-west monsoon.
—झञ्झा-
वात, अस्, m. wind with rain, a storm, a squall.
